purchases.title: Mr. Meadow: Bitcoin Deserves Better Visuals
purchases.summary:
Mr. Meadow is a Bitcoin artist and filmmaker in India. He prices the work in sats. The site is mrmeadow.org.
He found Bitcoin in 2017 through a friend and bought some, then spent the next years on altcoins because he could not yet tell signal from noise. He designed for a friend's wallet company, spent time at Deloitte, and worked with a Polkadot India team that was training coders in Rust and chasing funding. purchases.title: Bitbrand: Bitcoin Saved My Life
purchases.summary:
Bitbrand makes hand-branded Bitcoin goods the old way: steel, fire, and leather. No ink, no printer, and no two pieces alike. He invented the Bitcoin branding iron, calls himself the branding iron broker, and built the company from the back of a van.
In this episode of Share Your Bitcoin Journey, Bitcoin For The Arts founder Dion Wilson meets Bitbrand in Jersey City, after they first met at the Midwest Bitcoin Summit in Columbus. Bitbrand tells how Bitcoin saved his life, how an ATM on the Upper East Side changed what he did with his money, and how he got sober at 30 and quit the corporate job
